messages:
laura: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache OOM postmortem — pulling together action items, owners, and timelines. TL;DR: we have recurring 95p OOMs during peak prep window; likely mix of KV frag + slow GC on long-lived shards. I listed proposed fixes below and owners, please ack and update ETAs.

laura: Actions (short):
1) profiling sweep + flamegraphs for top 10 tenants (owner: sam)
2) GC tuning experiment + small heap flag rollout (owner: neil)
3) tighten per-shard limits + emergency eviction policy (owner: laura)
4) add OOM-pattern alert + aggregation dashboard (owner: jeff)
5) regression test harness for KV allocations (owner: maria)

sam: ack. will start profiling tonight, grabbing top tenants from prod for 24h window. planning to hand off artifacts by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

neil: ack for GC tuning. I'll prototype `--kv-gc-interval=30s` and `--compact-threshold=0.7` in staging. target PR by Wed. note: need perf run to validate tail latency.

maria: I'll spin up the regression harness using the `alloc-replay` traces. need a list of hot prefixes to simulate 95p traffic pattern. sam can you include that in your artifacts?

sam: yea — I'll include a `hot_prefixes.txt` in the artifact bundle and a small script to replay. artifact link: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/kv/profiles/1872500000 (permission: eng-runtime).

jeff: working on the dashboard. will create a composite alarm: OOM count + fragment_ratio > 0.6 over 10m. ETA for initial dashboard: tomorrow morning. also proposing a synthetic canary that runs daily at 03:00 UTC.

laura: plan for gradual rollout: 1) perf + regression tests green, 2) staging GC flags for 48h, 3) limited prod rollout to 10% shards, 4) 100% if green. owners please call out blockers asap.

neil: blocker: we need a low-risk way to revert GC flags; will add a `--gc-mode=off` hotswitch and a health-check guard in the PR.

maria: question: how do we validate fragmentation improvements? can we get before/after heap histograms and an allocation-age heatmap? sam?

sam: I'll include `heap-histogram.csv` and `alloc-age.png` per shard in the bundle. also adding perf script: ```./collect_kv_profile.sh --shard $SHARD --window 1h --outdir /tmp/artifacts```

jeff: added a paging rule to the oncall for 95p OOMs with shard_id tag. CI-bot will also post a summary for each alert.

ci-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-oom resolved. Auto-trigger: created runbook-task #342 for GC experiment across staging.

laura: good. owners please update this thread when you have PRs or artifacts. I'll compile a remediation timeline and share in Monday's postmortem follow-up doc. thanks everyone. :heart:

sam: ETA for artifact upload ~tomorrow 18:00 UTC.

neil: PR link once ready: https://git.redwood.dev/r/kv/+/change/gc-tuning (WIP)

maria: starting regression harness baseline tonight, will post results here.

jeff: dashboard draft: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/frag-oom-patterns (shared with eng-runtime)

laura: leaving a note — if we see a recurrence after these changes, we escalate to emergency eviction + autoshrink policy. prefer to avoid emergency in prod unless needed.

sam: understood. monitoring the 95p and 99p closely.

neil: will also add a short runbook snippet in the PR describing rollback and quick toggles.

laura: thanks — closing thread for now, will reopen if new signals come in.
